findings.title: DETAIL1 cell navigation bypasses dirty description guard
findings.expected: Dirty description must offer Finish/Discard/Stay before selection/revision changes. Stay keeps draft and owner; Finish saves once before navigation; Discard keeps accepted document.
findings.actual: Click gate recognizes polygon.hex, not polygon.detail-cell-target. Detail SVG click and Enter/Space invoke selectDetailCell directly. It accepts selection despite registered dirty preparation navigation and draft key, changes revision and remounts keyed editor, dropping local draft.
findings.method: Fresh independent agent inspected exact source and reproduced real App handler route through temporary instrumented generation harness. Browser DOM reproduction not claimed.
limits: SVG target.closest behavior modeled from actual source selector; no actual pointer DOM dispatch because Chromium launch socket EPERM.
Local draft loss follows React owner:revision remount contract; accepted persisted description not corrupted.
